publicationNote: Machine-local paths are recorded symbolically (<user-home>, <omo-home>); the recorded revision is the canonical original raw SHA-256 of the current live file, and the duplicate U path is a symlink to the canonical A file (the same live file, not two independent copies). The single shipped body is publication-sanitized, so its publishedRevision in skills.json differs from these live-byte revisions; the canonical/loser relationship itself is unchanged.
rule: Duplicate skill IDs are never merged and never overwritten. The canonical source follows inventory precedence (A user-install row is primary; the U copy is recorded as the duplicate). When both copies are byte-equal the canonical body ships once and the duplicate stays nonactivated. Differing content would ship as preserved variants with nonactivation, never as an invented merged body.
precedenceBasis: Plan inventory contract: A/omo-check row I4-21 is the primary personal-ops skill; U/agent/skills/omo-check row I4-29 is its duplicate (Duplicate ID risk. Guard against split edits). Native loader behavior on same-name collisions is first-wins with an explicit collision diagnostic; the loser is recorded, not merged.

canonical.disposition: canonical body shipped once as skills/omo-check/SKILL.md; the shipped bytes are publication-sanitized, so they are not byte-equal to these live bytes (publishedRevision in skills.json)

duplicate.disposition: nonactivated; the U path is a symlink to the canonical A file (same live file, never edited, never shipped as a second copy)

duplicates.equality: same live file through both paths: the U path is a symlink to the canonical A file, so both paths resolve to identical bytes (raw SHA-256 7f2c1707106039d4758b41f6776fe21446f4f4d096e0068d173ef157baa8a493/6971 at observation 2026-09-24); this supersedes the earlier independent-copy observation (4342cf5e97dc7620f0d9a11e74b3e4429c3f894b667b0edb6d4dba76771ea474/4791, byte-equal at the time); single activation, no variant needed
duplicates.selection: canonical A source ships; duplicate U copy is the recorded loser on collision
